conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Edward calling from Amazon Account Security. I'm reaching out regarding a recent high-value order placed on your account for a MacBook Pro. We noticed it was shipped to Texas, but your usual location is different. Are you aware of this purchase?
No, I didn't order any MacBook. My account is only used for books and small things. What's going on?

Thank you for confirming. It does appear suspicious. To ensure your Amazon account is secure, I'll just need to verify a few details with you before I can proceed to cancel that order. Can you confirm your full name and the email linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, my name is Linda Evans. The email is linda.evans@email.com. Is my account at risk?

Thank you, Linda. I understand how concerning this must be. We take security very seriously, and I'll do everything I can to help you. For added verification, may I have the last four digits of the phone number on your Amazon account?
It's 4127. Please don't let anyone access my account.

You're doing the right thing by acting quickly. To stop any unauthorized charges and secure your account, I need you to follow our secure resolution process. First, please open your web browser and go to www.amazon-safeguard.com to connect with our fraud department.
Okay, I'm typing that in now. Is this a real Amazon site?
Yes, that's our secure customer resolution portal to handle urgent account issues. Once the page loads, let me know what you see so I can guide you through the process.
It says 'Amazon Security Connect.' There's a spot to enter my name and email.
Perfect. Please enter your name and email as we verified earlier. After you sign in, a secure chat box will open. Let me know when you see it.
Done. I see the chat box now. What should I do next?

Great. You've now entered the secure session. Now, in order to block the unauthorized transaction, our system will prompt you for an account verification code. Please check your email and let me know the code you receive.
I just got an email from 'Amazon Security' with a 6-digit code. Do you need it?
Yes, please provide that code so I can proceed to freeze the fraudulent activity on your account and protect your funds.
The code is 849230. I hope this stops them.

Thank you. The unauthorized order is now on hold, but there's an outstanding transfer attempt associated with your account. To fully secure your funds, we need to temporarily move your Amazon balance to a secure resolution account. This is a standard procedure to protect your assets.
Move my balance? I'm not sure I understand. Is that safe?

Absolutely, Linda. This is a routine Amazon protocol to prevent fraudulent withdrawals. Only our fraud team can access the secure account. Once resolved, your balance will be restored. May I confirm which bank you use for Amazon payments?
I use First National Bank for my Amazon payments.
Thank you. You'll now receive instructions to transfer the funds to our secure Amazon Fraud Protection account ending in 3921. This will ensure no unauthorized party can access your money.
Do I do this through my online banking? How much do I need to send?

Yes, please log in to your online banking and prepare a wire transfer for $3,250, which matches your current Amazon balance. I'll provide the secure account details. Please let me know when you're ready.
Okay, I'm looking at my online banking now. What details should I use?

Here are the details: Beneficiary name 'Amazon Fraud Resolution', Account number 778293921, Routing number 064103230, Bank of America. Please enter those exactly, and let me know once the transfer is complete.
Alright, I'm entering it now. It's asking for a reason for the transfer, should I just put Amazon Security?

Yes, please enter 'Amazon Security' as the reason. This will ensure our fraud team recognizes the transfer and processes it immediately. Once submitted, please send me a screenshot of the confirmation page.
I just submitted the transfer and took a screenshot. How do I send it to you?
You can upload the screenshot directly in the secure chat box on the website you visited earlier. That will help us expedite your case and ensure your funds are safe.
Uploading it now. Is there anything else I need to do?

That's all for now, Linda. The fraud team will confirm receipt shortly. Please do not make any other purchases on your Amazon account until we notify you. Thank you for acting quickly to protect your account.
